prompt: Review a pull request for security, performance and style. The three reviews are independent, and you want results fast.
why: Run the three focused reviews at the same time and merge the findings.
trap: The subtasks are fixed in advance, so no orchestrator needs to plan them.

prompt: To judge whether code is vulnerable, run the same check five times and flag it if most runs agree.
tells: run the same check five times
why: Voting: several independent attempts in parallel for higher confidence.
trap: Evaluator-optimizer refines one draft in sequence; voting compares independent attempts.

prompt: Summarize each of a book's 40 chapters, then combine the summaries. Chapters can be summarized independently.
why: Map the chapters in parallel, then reduce.
trap: Doing them one after another works, just 40 times slower.

prompt: Answer the user's question while, at the same time, a separate call checks the request for policy violations.
tells: at the same time, a separate call checks
why: Sectioning: independent concerns run concurrently, so the check adds no latency.
trap: Chaining the check first would delay every answer.
